answer.reason: Bethel is the scene of Jacob's naming of the place, Jeroboam's golden calf and Josiah's destruction of the altar, so a line of three events is warranted.

clauses.english: was where Jacob set up a stone pillar and named the place Bethel
clauses.quote: he called the name of that place Bethel

clauses.english: had a golden calf set up in it by Jeroboam
clauses.quote: he set the one in Bethel

clauses.english: had its altar and high place broken down and burned by Josiah
clauses.quote: both that altar and the high place he brake down

doubts: GEN 28:19 does not itself say what Jacob saw; the dream is only implied by the context verses given.
1KI 13:1 and 1KI 13:4 (the man of God against the altar) were left out as a separate event and for the limit on clauses.
1KI 16:34 (Hiel the Bethelite) names a man from Bethel, not the place itself, so it was not used.
JDG 1:22-25 (the house of Joseph taking the city) and 2CH 13:19 (Abijah taking the city) were left out for brevity.
